title: The Gambia: a country built around a river

upload.title: This country is just a river 🇬🇲🗺️ The Gambia
upload.description: The Gambia is the smallest country on mainland Africa, surrounded by Senegal except for its Atlantic coast. It follows the Gambia River inland and is less than 50 km wide.

scenes.title: This country is just a *river*.
scenes.vo: This country is just a river, winding its way through the West African landscape.
scenes.caption: This country is just a river, winding its way through the West African landscape.

scenes.title: The *Gambia*
scenes.vo: The Gambia is the smallest country on mainland Africa, almost entirely enclosed by its larger neighbor.
scenes.caption: The Gambia is the smallest country on mainland Africa, almost entirely enclosed by its larger neighbor.

scenes.title: Surrounded by *Senegal*
scenes.vo: It is completely surrounded by Senegal on every single side, except for a short stretch of Atlantic coastline.
scenes.caption: It is completely surrounded by Senegal on every single side, except for a short stretch of Atlantic coastline.

scenes.title: Following the *river*
scenes.vo: The borders of the nation strictly follow the course of the Gambia River as it reaches deep inland.
scenes.caption: The borders of the nation strictly follow the course of the Gambia River as it reaches deep inland.

scenes.title: Less than *50 km* wide
scenes.vo: Throughout almost its entire length, the country remains remarkably narrow, staying less than fifty kilometers wide.
scenes.caption: Throughout almost its entire length, the country remains remarkably narrow, staying less than fifty kilometers wide.

scenes.title: Capital: *Banjul*
scenes.vo: Its capital city is Banjul, positioned right at the strategic mouth where the river empties into the ocean.
scenes.caption: Its capital city is Banjul, positioned right at the strategic mouth where the river empties into the ocean.
